description: Rank a named board of nonnegative evidence scores for review. By default valid_evalues=false: arbitrary nonnegative scores are ranked descriptively and selected stays empty. Set valid_evalues=true only when every input has a justified null expectation at most one; then e-Benjamini-Hochberg (e-BH) controls this family's expected false-discovery proportion at alpha, provided the supplied e-values are valid. The server cannot certify that assertion. Raw returns, z-scores, model confidence and did_it_change's monitoring statistic do not qualify as valid e-values. Use this after constructing evidence, not to detect a change from a time series. Returns ranked (metric/evidence pairs, descending score), selected, k, n_watched, threshold, descriptive_mean, validity, assumptions and guarantee. Threshold and board_evidence are null without e-value confirmation. Repeated boards are not automatically controlled. Example descriptive call: {"evidence":{"latency":12,"errors":3},"valid_evalues":false}.

alpha.description: Target expected false-discovery proportion for this supplied family, default 0.10 (10%), strictly between 0 and 1. Only controls selection conditionally when valid_evalues=true; it is not a per-metric probability.

additionalProperties.description: Nonnegative evidence score for this metric; zero is allowed. Magnitude alone does not prove e-value validity.

evidence.description: Map 1–128 nonempty metric names (up to 128 characters) to finite nonnegative scores; larger scores rank first, ties use metric name. Valid e-values are dimensionless; unverified scores receive descriptive ranking only.

valid_evalues.description: Caller assertion that every score is a valid e-value with defined null, sampling/selection procedure and observation window. Default false performs ranking only. True enables conditional e-BH; it does not validate provenance or the statistical construction.

name: which_metrics_matter

anyOf.description: Existing tool-error payload; no successful result fields are implied.

error.description: Validation or computation failure message; inspect MCP isError or the HTTP status.

outputSchema.description: A complete nonempty supplied-family result, including unverified rankings. Empty input is a tool error. Tool errors retain the separate error-message shape.

alpha.description: Requested expected false-discovery proportion bound, conditional on valid e-values.

anyOf.description: Mean supplied valid e-values; null without attestation.

board_evidence.description: Mean supplied valid e-values; null without attestation. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

descriptive_mean.description: Mean supplied values, without certifying their statistical construction.

error.description: Validation or computation failure message; inspect MCP isError or the HTTP status.

anyOf.description: Conditional e-BH statement; null for unverified inputs.

guarantee.description: Conditional e-BH statement; null for unverified inputs. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

ranked.description: Inputs sorted by decreasing value then name.

selected.description: Names selected only when the caller attests valid e-values.

anyOf.description: e-BH threshold; null without the caller's validity attestation.

threshold.description: e-BH threshold; null without the caller's validity attestation. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

valid_evalues.description: Caller attestation, not a server certification.
